program.title: LiNKsites — autonomous website factory and managed-website business

modules.title: Product and Tier Governance
modules.purpose: Governs product outcomes, tier specifications, add-ons, and exclusions.

modules.title: Design Intelligence Operations
modules.purpose: Governs design tokens and site design profile resolution.

modules.title: Component and Frontend Platform
modules.purpose: Governs the Component Registry and real apps/web-master components.

modules.title: Vertical Kit Operations
modules.purpose: Governs vertical kit lifecycle and production patterns.

modules.title: Reusable Site Foundation Production
modules.purpose: Governs reusable foundation lifecycle and adaptation contracts.

modules.title: Preview Inventory Management
modules.purpose: Governs preview inventory reservations and cost records.

phases.title: Preview inventory management
phases.objective: Match and reserve one compatible reusable foundation without conflicting reservations.

issues.title: Reserve foundation inventory
issues.objective: Reserve a compatible foundation/template inventory item for the accepted preview request.

modules.title: Preview Request Intake and Planning
modules.purpose: Validates preview requests and produces site specifications.

phases.title: Lead intake and qualification
phases.objective: Accept and qualify one canonical lead package for the private demo.

issues.title: Pull and validate lead research
issues.objective: Validate the canonical lead/research package before any website work.

issues.title: Create the private-demo Program
issues.objective: Idempotently create or recover the private-demo Program graph.

issues.title: Qualify vertical compatibility
issues.objective: Confirm the lead can use an approved vertical foundation.

issues.title: Verify exact library artifacts
issues.objective: Verify the exact approved LiNKlibraries artifacts and SHA receipts.

modules.title: Prospect Site Adaptation
modules.purpose: Applies the prospect adaptation contract atop a reserved foundation.

phases.title: Prospect site adaptation
phases.objective: Bind the approved foundation and exact library inputs to this prospect before content production.

issues.title: Build site specification and assembly manifest
issues.objective: Produce the lead-specific site specification and assembly manifest from the reserved foundation and verified library.

modules.title: Content and Media Production
modules.purpose: Produces grounded copy, media plans, and provenance manifests.

phases.title: Lead-specific content and media
phases.objective: Produce grounded copy and provenance-bearing media inputs.

issues.title: Create information architecture and copy
issues.objective: Create lead-specific information architecture and copy inputs.

issues.title: Source and process media
issues.objective: Source/process media with a durable provenance manifest.

issues.title: Assemble working-content version
issues.objective: Assemble and validate one immutable working-content version.

issues.title: Run content and quality gates
issues.objective: Record evidence-backed content, schema, quality, security, privacy, and asset gate results.

modules.title: Working-to-Payload Promotion
modules.purpose: Operates the sole trusted path from working records to Payload drafts.

phases.title: Working-to-Payload promotion
phases.objective: Promote only an accepted exact working-content version to Payload draft and verify parity.

issues.title: Promote exact version to Payload draft
issues.objective: Promote only the accepted working version to a Payload draft.

issues.title: Run CMS read-back parity gate
issues.objective: Read the draft back and record field-level parity evidence.

modules.title: Preview Deployment and Validation
modules.purpose: Builds, tests, and validates private preview releases.

phases.title: Private Payload preview
phases.objective: Promote the accepted version to a private, non-indexable preview and verify it.

issues.title: Publish private preview
issues.objective: Publish only to the authorized private preview environment.

issues.title: Render and validate the private site
issues.objective: Render and validate the complete private preview.

modules.title: Preview Outcome, Upgrade, Recycling
modules.purpose: Handles Outcome Records and Conversion Lock wiring.

phases.title: Evidence and completion
phases.objective: Capture final evidence and emit one replay-safe completion record.

issues.title: Capture functional, visual, SEO, accessibility, and privacy evidence
issues.objective: Capture the required final evidence receipts for the private preview.

issues.title: Emit CRM-shaped completion record
issues.objective: Emit exactly one evidence-backed completion record for the accepted private demo.

modules.title: Paid-Order Intake and Customer Finalization
modules.purpose: Validates paid activation packages and customer site instances.

modules.title: Production Publication and Launch Certification
modules.purpose: Operates launch readiness and launch certification.

modules.title: Domain, DNS, TLS, and Hosting Provisioning
modules.purpose: Provisions approved custom hostnames and hosting assignments.

modules.title: Site Operations, Monitoring, and Recovery
modules.purpose: Operates monitoring, incidents, and recovery.

modules.title: Customer Changes and Service Evolution
modules.purpose: Handles entitlement-bounded customer change requests.

modules.title: Capacity, Regional Placement, and Infrastructure Scaling
modules.purpose: Operates capacity and placement decisions.

modules.title: Suspension, Export, Termination, and Decommissioning
modules.purpose: Handles suspension, export, and decommissioning.

modules.purpose: Operates cross-cutting quality, cost, and performance improvement.
